subject: Activation incentive slate and contingency breaks for Nova Labs onramp
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@novalabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation incentive slate and contingency breaks for Nova Labs onramp

Sara — great to meet briefly on Friday. Quick recap and the incentive slate we discussed so the internal team and procurement have the same picture. I put the options in order of preference (lower cost to us first) and a contingency / rollback clause to address procurement risk.

Summary of proposal (hosted API, usage-based):
- Launch credits: $15k equivalent in hosted API credits (approx. 300k tokens) applied up front at activation to cover initial integration and smoke testing.
- Staged burn credits: additional $25k in credits released in two tranches: 50% at go-live + integration signoff; 50% after 60 days if minimum usage thresholds are met (see thresholds below).
- Commit tiering: if Nova Labs signs a 12-month committed usage agreement (baseline X USD/month), we extend a 20% per-token discount on the remainder of billed usage. Without a commit, standard list rates apply.
- Contingency / rollback: if thresholds are not met by day 90, discounts will step down to 10% for the remainder of the term and remaining staged credits will expire.

Thresholds (example):
- Integration signoff: smoke tests completed, basic calls per minute validated.
- 60-day threshold: sustained average of 50k tokens/day for 14 of the 30 days prior to the tranche release.

Procurement asks from your side: billing contact + PO cadence, any SOC2 evidence requests, and preferred SOW cadence for signature (we can do DocuSign).

Attachments: SOW draft (high level), pricing breakdown spreadsheet with token-to-dollar mapping for the proposed tiers.

If that looks fine, we can circulate a short SOW + term sheet for legal and procurement. Happy to lower the up-front credits slightly in exchange for a firmer commit if procurement prefers lower initial spend.

Next step: are you available Tues 10am PT to loop in procurement and legal?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of GTM — West
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments (referenced): SOW_NovaLabs_v1.pdf (draft), activation-pricing-breakdown-20270509.xlsx
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@novalabs.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@novalabs.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation incentive slate and contingency breaks for Nova Labs onramp

Thanks Lauren — this is helpful. A couple of quick clarifying questions from procurement / product:

1) Do the launch credits expire after 90 days from grant, or do they carry through the first billing cycle?
2) The contingency rollback (20% -> 10%) — is that a hard step-down tied only to usage thresholds, or can it be waived if Nova Labs provides a corrective plan?
3) Any blackout on combining these launch credits with a trial promo we might have already planned for internal pilots?

We can do Tue 10am PT. I’ll bring our procurement lead (cc’d) and legal if needed.

Best,
Sara Holt
VP Product, Nova Labs
Sara.Holt@novalabs.com

On Sun, May 9, 2027 at 09:12 AM Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Sara — great to meet briefly on Friday. Quick recap and the incentive slate we discussed...
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation incentive slate and contingency breaks for Nova Labs onramp

Looping in a quick note from Sales Ops / Finance perspective. I like the structure — low upfront + staged tranches — but finance flagged the total exposure (approx $40k credits + discount runway) as higher than typical for a net-new mid-market account without a signed commit. Options we can consider to reduce exposure:

- Convert $15k launch credit -> $10k + extend staged tranche triggers (i.e., make tranche 1 conditional on a signed 12-month LOA).
- Make credits refundable only against future invoice (credit ledger) rather than an immediate straight grant.
- Add a cap on discounted volume (e.g., discount applies up to Y tokens/month, over that billed at list until commit re-negotiation).

I attached a quick excel with modeled exposures under each option (activation-pricing-breakdown-20270509.xlsx). If you think Nova Labs will push for the larger upfront, I can ask finance for a one-off exception but need an internal approval note.

Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: activation-pricing-breakdown-20270509.xlsx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@novalabs.com>, procurement@novalabs.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation incentive slate and contingency breaks for Nova Labs onramp

Sara — thanks for the questions and for scheduling. Quick responses and the next steps below.

1) Credits expiration: launch credits will be valid for 120 days from grant; staged credits must be earned per tranche and expire 30 days after tranche eligibility window if not used. We can extend expiry by written exception if Nova Labs provides a remediation plan before the expiry window.

2) Contingency rollback: rolling back the discount is an automated step tied to the usage thresholds. That said, we will consider a documented remediation plan to cure a miss within a 30-day window to avoid an immediate step-down — requires written approval from Sales Ops and Finance.

3) Promo stacking: we prefer not to stack multiple vendor promos for the same account (internal pilots vs external launch credits). If Nova Labs has an internal pilot promo, we can map those usage allowances into the staged credit program instead of double-crediting.

Action items:
- I’ll circulate an SOW + short term sheet for signature (attached SOW_NovaLabs_v1.pdf) with the adjusted credit expiries above.
- Ben — please confirm which exposure option you want to present to finance; if you want the $15k upfront we’ll need the approvals note.
- Sara — procurement, please confirm preferred DocuSign recipients and PO cadence; we’ll prepare the DocuSign packet after you confirm.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/placeholder-sign-novalabs
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DL-2027-0423

Thanks all — looking forward to getting Nova Labs live.

Lauren Bishop
